symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1 in VLAN 30

diagnoses.diagnosis: Network connectivity issue due to interface down
diagnoses.root_cause: gigabitethernet0/0.10 is administratively down
diagnoses.recommendation: Bring interface gigabitethernet0/0/10 down to its current administrative state via 'show interface gigabitethernet0/0' and then 'no shutdown' interface gigabitethernet0/0.10

symptom: PC2 assigned 169.254.x.x APIPA address

diagnoses.diagnosis: APIPA Address Assignment
diagnoses.root_cause: DHCP pool exhaustion
diagnoses.recommendation: Assign a static IP address to PC2

symptom: PC1 can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot open google.com

diagnoses.diagnosis: DNS Resolution Issue
diagnoses.root_cause: DNS Server Not Configured or Not Available
diagnoses.recommendation: Check and configure the DNS server settings on PC1, or ensure the DNS server is available and not blocked by the network

symptom: R1 and R2 fail to form OSPF adjacency

diagnoses.diagnosis: OSPF neighbor timeout due to inconsistent hello interval configuration
diagnoses.root_cause: Different OSPF hello intervals configured on R1 and R2
diagnoses.recommendation: Adjust OSPF hello interval configuration on R1 and R2 to match each other

symptom: Web server port 80 unreachable from Sales subnet

diagnoses.diagnosis: ACL Deny Rule Blocking Required Traffic
diagnoses.root_cause: ACL deny rule configured to block incoming traffic on port 80
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and adjust the ACL deny rule to allow incoming traffic on port 80

symptom: Internal PCs cannot access external internet

diagnoses.diagnosis: NAT Overload
diagnoses.root_cause: PAT keyword is missing
diagnoses.recommendation: Enable PAT (Port Address Translation) on the NAT settings

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi users can access internal private servers

diagnoses.diagnosis: Unauthorized access through guest VLAN ACL
diagnoses.root_cause: Guest ACL is overly permissive and lacks sufficient security restrictions
diagnoses.recommendation: Restrict guest VLAN ACL to only allow necessary traffic, using a more restrictive ACL configuration

symptom: Trunk link between SW1 and SW2 failing to carry VLAN 20 traffic

diagnoses.diagnosis: Trunk link failure due to missing VLAN
diagnoses.root_cause: VLAN 20 not configured on the trunk link between SW1 and SW2
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify VLAN 20 is enabled on the trunk link configuration and ensure it is included in the allowed VLAN list.

symptom: PC3 gets correct IP but cannot ping default gateway 192.168.1.1

diagnoses.diagnosis: Incorrect default gateway configuration
diagnoses.root_cause: The PC3 is configured with a default gateway IP that is not reachable
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify the default gateway IP and ensure it is reachable

symptom: Switch SW1 management interface unreachable via SSH

diagnoses.diagnosis: Management SVI is administratively shut down
diagnoses.root_cause: SVI shutdown policy is enabled
diagnoses.recommendation: Check and verify the SVI shutdown policy configuration on SW1

symptom: PC1 and PC2 in VLAN 10 cannot ping each other across switch

diagnoses.diagnosis: Inter-switch link is not configured as trunk, causing VLAN isolation and preventing pinging between PC1 and PC2.
diagnoses.root_cause: INTER_SWITCH_ACCESS_MODE rule is set to access instead of trunk.
diagnoses.recommendation: Change the INTER SWITCH_ACCESS_MODE rule to trunk on the affected switch to enable VLAN trunking.

symptom: Branch router R2 missing routes to Head Office networks

diagnoses.diagnosis: Branch router R2 is configured as a passive OSPF link
diagnoses.root_cause: Incorrect OSPF configuration
diagnoses.recommendation: Configure OSPF on Branch router R2

symptom: Finance PC cannot access Finance Server in VLAN 40

diagnoses.diagnosis: Incorrect VLAN assignment on switch port
diagnoses.root_cause: Switch port is assigned to an incorrect access VLAN
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and correct VLAN assignment on the affected switch port

symptom: DHCP Relay failing for remote branch subnet

diagnoses.diagnosis: DHCP Relay Helper IP Address Missing
diagnoses.root_cause: Insufficient configuration on the router or switch connecting the remote branch subnet
diagnoses.recommendation: Configure the DHCP relay helper IP address on the router or switch

symptom: Static route traffic dropping intermittently

diagnoses.diagnosis: Static Route Next Hop Unreachable
diagnoses.root_cause: Static route configuration error
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify static route configuration for the affected interface and correct next hop IP address if necessary

symptom: FTP connections to File Server timing out

diagnoses.diagnosis: FTP control port 21 is missing from the ACL rule
diagnoses.root_cause: Insufficient ACL configuration
diagnoses.recommendation: Update ACL rules to include FTP control port 21

symptom: Static NAT mapping for Internal Web Server not working

diagnoses.diagnosis: NAT INSIDE DIRECTION MISSING
diagnoses.root_cause: NAT configuration not properly configured on the internal interface
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and correct NAT INSIDE DIRECTION settings on the internal interface

symptom: Wireless clients unable to authenticate to WPA2 Enterprise

diagnoses.diagnosis: Authentication failure due to mismatched RADIUS shared secret
diagnoses.root_cause: Inconsistent RADIUS server configuration
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and synchronize RADIUS server configuration, including shared secret

symptom: Native VLAN mismatch warnings flooding switch logs

diagnoses.diagnosis: Native VLAN mismatch warning
diagnoses.root_cause: Trunk configuration inconsistency
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify trunk peer configurations and ensure consistency in native VLAN settings

symptom: PC unable to communicate with hosts outside local subnet

diagnoses.diagnosis: Insufficient or misconfigured gateway settings
diagnoses.root_cause: Default gateway is not configured to route traffic outside the local subnet
diagnoses.recommendation: Configure the default gateway to route traffic outside the local subnet

symptom: OSPF route redistribution failing between OSPF and EIGRP

diagnoses.diagnosis: Missing subnets option in OSPF redistribution
diagnoses.root_cause: OSPF configuration not set to include subnets
diagnoses.recommendation: Enable the OSPF subnets option in the OSPF redistribution rule

symptom: Users unable to reach external HTTPS sites

diagnoses.diagnosis: HTTPS port 443 is missing in the ACL
diagnoses.root_cause: Configuration error in network ACL
diagnoses.recommendation: Update the ACL to include port 443 for HTTPS traffic

symptom: Duplicate IP address conflict detected on LAN

diagnoses.diagnosis: Duplicate IP address conflict
diagnoses.root_cause: Conflicting IP addresses from multiple devices on the LAN
diagnoses.recommendation: Check and configure IP addresses on all devices connected to the LAN to ensure unique IP addresses

symptom: VTP updates not propagating across switches

diagnoses.diagnosis: VTP Domain Mismatch
diagnoses.root_cause: VTP domain names do not match exactly
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and update VTP domain names to match across all switches

symptom: Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) dropping legitimate traffic

diagnoses.diagnosis: Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) dropping legitimate traffic due to DAI_TRUST_MISSING rule
diagnoses.root_cause: Uplink trunk is not configured as DAI trusted
diagnoses.recommendation: Configure the uplink trunk as DAI trusted

symptom: Port Security putting switch port into err-disabled state

diagnoses.diagnosis: Port Security Mismatch
diagnoses.root_cause: Incompatible port security settings
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and adjust port security settings to ensure compatibility

symptom: HSRP Standby router continuously taking over Active role

diagnoses.diagnosis: HSRP Standby router continuously taking over Active role due to inconsistent HSRP timers
diagnoses.root_cause: Inconsistent HSRP timers between Active and Standby routers
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and synchronize HSRP timers on all routers in the HSRP group

symptom: Router sub-interface encapsulation missing dot1q tag

diagnoses.diagnosis: Missing 802.1Q Encapsulation on Router Sub-Interface
diagnoses.root_cause: Incorrect configuration or missing configuration for 802.1Q encapsulation on the router sub-interface
diagnoses.recommendation: Verify and correct the 802.1Q encapsulation configuration on the router sub-interface

symptom: IPv6 SLAAC clients not receiving prefix information

diagnoses.diagnosis: IPv6 SLAAC clients not receiving prefix information due to suppression of IPv6 Router Advertisements
diagnoses.root_cause: Router configuration or firmware issue preventing IPv6 Router Advertisements
diagnoses.recommendation: Check and enable IPv6 Router Advertisements on the router

symptom: CDP neighbor discovery failing between Cisco devices

diagnoses.diagnosis: CDP Neighbor Discovery Issue
diagnoses.root_cause: Global CDP disabled on the device
diagnoses.recommendation: Enable CDP globally on the device and verify the settings
